# Enrollment

## Summary
One learner's seat in one cohort: status (Enrollment Status), dates, payment ref, certificate link. Progress and completion are computed by Learner Progress, never stored.

## Usage
Created by Enroll Learner; completed by Issue Certificate.

## Non-goals
No grades stored here.
